purpose: Barrick Mining peer-normalization input. Internal ticker ABX maps to NYSE:B / TSX:ABX. No live execution.
change_note: Adds H1 2026 gold all-in sustaining cost per ounce (aisc_usd_per_oz, the gold alias of the CYCLICAL_MINING cost_position unit-cost slot) for ABX and all four peers, and LTM net debt / EBITDA for AEM and KGC. Balance sheet now has four eligible peer values. Cost position still has only three: Agnico Eagle reports AISC per ounce of gold produced (production basis with an inventory adjustment) instead of per ounce sold, so its value is stored but not score-eligible. The dataset therefore stays blocked on cost_position and config/peer_universes.yaml keeps ABX at INSUFFICIENT.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_definition: (total debt - cash and cash equivalents) / LTM EBITDA; EBITDA = net earnings + income and mining tax expense + finance costs + depreciation, depletion and amortization (unadjusted); LTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025; Agnico Eagle has no current portion of long-term debt
net_debt_to_ebitda.source: Agnico Eagle second quarter 2026 results (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1)
net_debt_to_ebitda.filing_or_report_id: 0001104659-26-088794 (balance sheet 2026-06-30, H1 2026 and H1 2025 EBITDA); 0001104659-26-014451 (FY2025 EBITDA, Q4 2025 results Exhibit 99.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2809/000110465926014451/aem-20251231xex99d1.htm)
net_debt_to_ebitda.calculation_method: LTM EBITDA = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025, company-reported EBITDA (net income + finance costs + amortization + income and mining tax)
net_debt_to_ebitda.notes: Unadjusted EBITDA is used so that AEM and KGC share one definition (Kinross reports no EBITDA). ABX and NEM use company adjusted EBITDA and AU its own leverage ratio; all five are net cash, so the definitional gap is small. Agnico's adjusted EBITDA would give (196.825 - 3463.957) / (8089.782 + 5748.429 - 3503.707) = -0.316.

aisc_usd_per_oz.source_definition: all-in sustaining costs per ounce on a by-product basis, measured per ounce of gold PRODUCED (production basis with an inventory adjustment); NTI Payments at Meadowbank excluded (company deviation from WGC guidance)
aisc_usd_per_oz.source: Agnico Eagle second quarter 2026 results (Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1)
aisc_usd_per_oz.calculation_method: as reported by the company (six-month column); components stored in raw_value
aisc_usd_per_oz.notes: Not score-eligible: Agnico Eagle reports AISC only per ounce of production, while ABX, NEM, KGC and AU report per ounce sold. The company publishes no AISC dollar total, so a per-ounce-sold figure cannot be derived without mixing a production-basis numerator with a sales-basis denominator (docs/PEER_DATA_STANDARD.md rule 5). Making it eligible needs an owner decision that production-basis AISC is comparable.
